items.description: Since time immemorial, it was believed that if the light falls on the roof of the temple on the first full moon of autumn, then darkness will arrive. And only a bear cub named Cherry blossom, named after the ancient wise tree, will be able to overcome the darkness.Before the last petal falls from the wise tree, the bear cub must have time to find and overcome the darkness and its inhabitants.One day, darkness overtook Japan, as the prophecy said.Many residents fell into despair and joined the ranks of darkness.In one of the remote villages, a bear cub was born - plump and nimble. He was born on the day of Sakura blossoming, and it was decided to name him in honor of this event.The little bear was mischievous, he liked to jump, when he went out into the yard with his friends, he jumped every now and then - sometimes he played tag with jumping over obstacles, sometimes tag, sometimes hopscotch.One day, the mother bear went to the temple to find out what kind of bad weather had come, why there was no harvest, why the sun was shining less and less often. The wise old man in the temple said that darkness had come, the prophecy had come true.You are about to go on a great adventure and learn history.The game is based on the short story "The Legend of a Little Bear Named Cherry blossom" by Sveta Sky.Some images, backgrounds, characters, and styles are created by artificial intelligence. Translations into other languages ​​were done manually using a translator. The developer and text author is Sveta Sky. The game is built using the Godot 4.5 engine.Detailed information about the freely available assets can be found in the description in the game itself, as well as in the game folder.Game controls:WSAD - forward, backward, left, right.Left mouse button - weapon.Space - jump.R - restart.The game doesn't have saves, but there are several autosave checkpoint slots in the main menu so you can return to a scene with a story choice.The game takes between 1.5 and 3 hours to complete.Have fun! items.description: You are trapped in a labyrinth made of identical rooms that repeat endlessly. There are no maps. No references. Only decisions.Your objective is clear: advance floor after floor until you find the exit before anxiety completely consumes you.How the Game WorksEach floor consists of a central room with 4 doors. When you cross a door:You may advance to the next floor.You may remain on the same level.You may enter a safe room.To leave each floor, you must find a hidden key located somewhere within the rooms.The key’s location changes dynamically every time you enter a room, adding uncertainty and replayability.Once you obtain the key, you must choose correctly between the remaining doors to progress. A wrong decision can push you backward and cost you progress.Anxiety SystemAnxiety is a core gameplay mechanic.It increases progressively over time.It temporarily decreases when you find certain objects.It is reduced inside safe rooms.If anxiety reaches its maximum limit, the run ends.There are no physical enemies or traditional combat. The pressure comes from time, repetition, and constant uncertainty.Progression and StructureThe game consists of progressing through multiple floors of the labyrinth.There is only one ending.There are no branching narrative paths.There is no manual or automatic save system.Each run must be completed in a single session.The average playtime is approximately 1 hour, depending on the player’s decisions.Key FeaturesFirst-person exploration.Progression system based on strategic door selection.Anxiety management mechanic as a fail condition.Dynamic key placement with variable positions.Safe rooms that reduce anxiety levels.Minimalist and oppressive atmosphere.Atmospheric soundtrack designed to intensify tension.Short but intense psychological experience.What Kind of Experience It IsLabyrinth of Anxiety is a psychological experience focused on tension, repetition, and decision-making under pressure.It is designed for players who enjoy introspective, minimalist, and emotionally intense experiences.It is not an action or combat game.It is a game about moving forward… even when everything looks the same. items.description: Mole Mine Rocks 0.15 is a super fun clicker game mixing the addictive stuff of a standard clicker with cool features and upgrades. You run a mole mining operation, mining rocks and minerals to unlock upgrades and new levels. The game has addictive clicker gameplay where you click to mine rocks and get resources. The more you click, the more you mine! Explore normal and space levels with different challenges and rewards. Upgrade your clicking power to mine more rocks. Hire moles for passive income. Talk to the game through dynamic dialogue guiding you on your mining journey, and enjoy cutscenes adding to the story. Mine minerals to buy items and upgrades, managing resources to be more efficient. Watch out for leaks in your mine making you lose minerals over time. Fix leaks to stop losing minerals but be ready to spend minerals to do so. Invest in upgrades to improve mining and handle leaks and other problems. In Mole Mine Rocks 0.15, planning and managing resources are key to becoming the top mining tycoon. Can you make the best mining operation and beat all the levels? Start mining and find out!
